title: Waiting for Godot
tone_mechanism: Bleak existential content delivered through vaudeville double-act mechanics: the stage face and timing carry the joke while the content stays null (waiting, hunger, rope, boot). In performance the expressionless/pantomimic delivery is the flat surface; on the page the same effect must be rebuilt from clipped declaratives and withheld reaction — the canonical transfer case (claim 7). French original (1952) → English (Beckett's own revision, 1955); dates vary by language, 1953 = first French publication/performance.
